question: How many eggs are laid by female sparrows at a time?
solution:
The correct answer is '**Four to six**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The passage explicitly states the number of eggs laid by female sparrows at a time, which is **four to six**.
 
• This detail is part of the broader description of the reproduction process of sparrows.
 
• It further elaborates on the appearance of the eggs, noting they have reddish-brown blotches on white shells.
 
• The passage also covers the incubation period, which ranges from eleven to fourteen days, indicating the care taken by sparrows towards their offspring.

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 1**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Two to four**: This option provides a range that is lower than the one mentioned in the passage.
 
• **Six to eight**: This option exceeds the correct range of eggs laid by female sparrows.
 
• **Eight to ten**: This option significantly overestimates the number of eggs female sparrows lay at a time, according to the information provided in the passage.
